description: Azure provides cloud services from Microsoft. Learn subscriptions, resource groups, identities, storage and networking with small worked plans and no real deployment. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.

seo.title: Microsoft Azure Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Microsoft Azure with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
